description: Validates search-enabled scenarios through Search Hub's search maturity contract.

levels.name: Search maturity unavailable
levels.description: The target declares search ownership but Search Hub cannot inspect the search descriptor or provider corpus contract.
exit_criteria: A readable .vrooli/search.json exists with at least one provider descriptor.

levels.name: Search maturity inspectable
levels.description: The target's search descriptor is readable and provider entries can be inspected.
exit_criteria: Provider descriptors satisfy Search Hub registry invariants.

levels.name: Search maturity governed
levels.description: Search providers are routable and carry enough eval/readiness metadata to detect degraded search.
exit_criteria: Eval corpus and operational metadata are present.

levels.name: Search maturity baseline clean
levels.description: Search descriptor and baseline quality checks are clean enough for ordinary routing.
entry_criteria: No required search maturity findings remain.
exit_criteria: Production-quality AI search evidence is present.

levels.name: Search maturity production-ready
levels.description: Search providers have credible reviewed corpora, fresh live evidence, operational endpoint posture, tuning provenance, and enforced performance posture.
entry_criteria: No production-readiness search maturity findings remain.

capabilities.label: Search Descriptor
capabilities.description: Presence, parseability, scenario ownership, and registry-valid provider descriptors in .vrooli/search.json.

levels.name: Search descriptor missing
levels.description: The target declares search ownership but has no readable search descriptor.
levels.capability_summary: Search Hub cannot inspect the target's searchable corpora.
levels.next_unlock: A readable .vrooli/search.json with at least one provider descriptor.

levels.name: Search descriptor readable
levels.description: The search descriptor parses and declares provider entries.
levels.next_unlock: Provider descriptors satisfy Search Hub's registry contract.

levels.name: Provider descriptors valid
levels.description: Provider descriptors are active, scenario-owned, and registry-valid.
levels.next_unlock: Eval corpus and readiness/control posture are declared.

levels.name: Search descriptor clean
levels.description: Search descriptor checks are clean.
levels.next_unlock: No production-readiness search descriptor findings remain.

levels.name: Search descriptor production-ready
levels.description: Search descriptor checks are production-ready.

capabilities.label: Search Governance
capabilities.description: Provider ownership and declared governance metadata that make a search provider accountable to one scenario.

levels.name: Search governance absent
levels.description: Search provider ownership is missing or contradicts the owning scenario.
levels.capability_summary: Search provider ownership is not trustworthy.
levels.next_unlock: Provider ownership metadata matches the target scenario.

levels.name: Search governance aligned
levels.description: Provider ownership metadata is coherent.
levels.capability_summary: Search ownership is accountable to the target scenario.

levels.name: Search governance clean
levels.description: Search governance checks are clean.
levels.next_unlock: No production-readiness search governance findings remain.

levels.name: Search governance production-ready
levels.description: Search governance checks are production-ready.

capabilities.label: Search Eval Performance
capabilities.description: Declared eval corpus evidence used to prove and later refresh retrieval-quality maturity.

levels.name: Search eval evidence absent
levels.description: No eval corpus or an invalid corpus prevents retrieval-quality regression checks.
levels.capability_summary: Search eval quality cannot be measured.
levels.next_unlock: A labelled tests corpus with reviewed positive or negative cases.

levels.name: Search eval corpus inspectable
levels.description: Search eval inputs are declared and parseable.
levels.capability_summary: Search Hub can inspect search eval inputs.
levels.next_unlock: Live eval freshness and threshold evidence.

levels.name: Search eval evidence baseline clean
levels.description: Static eval corpus checks are clean. Live eval execution is reported separately when explicitly requested.
levels.next_unlock: Reviewed corpus depth, difficulty spread, fresh live-labelled runs, and performance evidence prove production-quality retrieval.

levels.name: Search eval evidence production-ready
levels.description: Reviewed corpus size, difficulty spread, live labels, fresh runs, and performance evidence prove production-quality retrieval.

capabilities.label: Search Operability
capabilities.description: Status/control endpoint posture and bounded tuning metadata for operating a search provider.

levels.name: Search operability undeclared
levels.description: Status or control endpoints are missing, or tuning exceeds declared query-budget posture.
levels.capability_summary: Search provider operations are not fully inspectable.
levels.next_unlock: Status/control endpoints and bounded tuning posture.

levels.name: Search operability inspectable
levels.description: Readiness/control posture and tuning metadata are declared enough for operators to inspect provider health.

levels.name: Search operability baseline clean
levels.description: Search operability checks are clean.
levels.next_unlock: Endpoint posture, tuning provenance, and measured latency/degradation budgets are production-ready.

levels.name: Search operability production-ready
levels.description: Endpoint posture, tuning provenance, and measured latency/degradation budgets are production-ready.

SEARCH_CONFIG_MISSING.reason: The provider owner must decide whether the scenario should expose search.

SEARCH_CONFIG_INVALID.reason: Descriptor repair depends on the owning provider's intended corpus.

SEARCH_PROVIDER_INVALID.reason: Provider endpoint and mapping choices are scenario-owned contracts.

SEARCH_PROVIDER_CLASS_MISSING.reason: The operability class depends on whether the provider owns a tunable index, computes live, or is external — a provider-owner judgment.

SEARCH_PROVIDER_GROUP_MISMATCH.reason: Ownership mismatch must be reconciled by the provider owner.

SEARCH_EVAL_CORPUS_MISSING.reason: Useful eval cases require domain judgment about expected search results.

SEARCH_EVAL_CORPUS_INADEQUATE.reason: Certification requires at least one reviewed positive and one junk negative; adding meaningful cases needs domain judgment.

SEARCH_EVAL_CORPUS_THIN.reason: Duplicate queries and single-band difficulty over-report recall; production certification requires a reviewed corpus with coverage depth.

SEARCH_EVAL_CORPUS_COVERAGE.reason: Declared provider coverage groups are production-readiness evidence; satisfying them requires provider-owner review.

SEARCH_EVAL_RUN_MISSING.reason: The provider owner must run the eval suite to create trustworthy freshness evidence.

SEARCH_EVAL_RUN_STALE.reason: Certification requires fresh eval evidence; refreshing it means running the provider-owned suite against live data.

SEARCH_EVAL_RUN_OUTDATED.reason: The latest run was produced under a tuning that no longer matches the descriptor; re-run under current tuning.

SEARCH_EVAL_RECALL_BELOW_TARGET.reason: Aggregate recall below the declared target means retrieval quality or corpus expectations need repair.

SEARCH_EVAL_ASSERT_FAILED.reason: A failed eval may require retrieval repair, corpus correction, or provider tuning.

SEARCH_EVAL_LABELS_STALE.reason: Stale labels require provider-owner judgment about expected ids and corpus drift.

SEARCH_EVAL_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.reason: Provider or eval-store liveness must be restored before Search Hub can prove live eval maturity.

SEARCH_REINDEX_ENDPOINT_MISSING.reason: An indexed (local_index/async) provider owns a rebuildable corpus; without a reindex endpoint Search Hub cannot reconcile or re-evaluate it. Reclassify as local_live if it computes results live.

SEARCH_STATUS_ENDPOINT_MISSING.reason: Production readiness requires a declared readiness posture; endpoint shape depends on the provider's live indexing architecture.

SEARCH_CONTROL_ENDPOINT_MISSING.reason: Production readiness requires either config write-back or a validated pinned/non-writable reason; the descriptor must make that posture explicit.

SEARCH_PERF_BUDGET_UNPROVEN.reason: The provider declared telemetry_required but produced no measurable latency; it opted in and must deliver evidence.

SEARCH_PERF_BUDGET_BREACH.reason: Production readiness requires measured performance to satisfy the provider's declared p95 budget.

SEARCH_PERF_SAMPLES_UNPROVEN.reason: A p95 or degradation rate derived from fewer cases than the provider declared is not production evidence.

SEARCH_PERF_DEGRADED.reason: Production readiness requires empty-result degradation to stay within the provider's declared budget.

SEARCH_TUNING_BUDGET_INVALID.reason: Latency budget tradeoffs need measured provider-specific evidence.
